name: Main Feedwater Pump Trip
description: Both main feedwater pumps trip. Steam generator levels fall, auxiliary feedwater actuates automatically, and low-low SG level trips the reactor if levels are not restored.
briefing: Feedwater is lost at t+25 s. Track SG levels, confirm auxiliary feedwater start, and manage the resulting reactor/turbine trip.
learning_objectives: Feedwater/steam mass balance in the steam generators
Role of auxiliary feedwater as a safety-grade heat-sink makeup
Low-low SG level as a reactor trip function
